title: Simultaneous normalized coefficient fibers and sections-limit resolution models
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$, and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale site with its independent universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention], the positive finite coefficient sheaves $B_n=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_W$, their completed limit $A=\lim_nB_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the actual strict coefficient sequence category, its evaluations $e_n$, exact scalar restriction $U$ and prescribed total limit $L=R\lim\,U$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. There exist coherent normalized reduction-and-fiber data $F$ of [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data] (the Lean structure CoefficientDerivedSystemFibers), and a natural isomorphism
$$\kappa:L\,;R\Gamma_A\ \cong\ U\,;R(\Gamma_A^{\mathbf N})\,;R\lim_{\mathrm{Ab}}.$$
The tensor-Hom, reduction and quotient maps in $F$ are the actual K-flat derived constructions [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], with the pure-tensor and simultaneous-representative normalizations in that structure. In particular $F$ includes its reduction adjunction to $L$, the actual unit/counit projections, normalized reductions, the finite quotient adjunctions, normalized tensor comparisons, the evaluation-defined beta comparison, normalized internal-Hom fibers with their actual transitions, joint detection of isomorphisms, and finite global-Hom identifications. Extend $F$ to calculus data $S$ by using $\kappa$ for its global-limit comparison and the proved evaluation-defined enriched-adjunction isomorphism for its enriched field. Then S admits simultaneous resolution coherence D [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]: ordinary scalar-section transport has its actual sectionwise adjunct formula; derived scalar-section comparisons extend that transport through the universal comparison units; termwise derived sections commute with each evaluation; finite global-Hom comparison is sections of its internal-Hom fiber after this evaluation comparison; and $\kappa$ satisfies the specified universal-unit equation induced by the ordinary sections/limit comparison. The conclusion includes no finite-projection, degree-zero-Hom, gamma-naturality or mapping-composition identity. All coefficient levels are positive, including Lean index zero. The chosen comparisons additionally satisfy CoefficientDerivedSystemProjectionModels [def-coef-derived-system-projection-models]: sections of total-limit projections are the finite sections projection maps for every system, and the finite scalar enriched comparison on H-zero is the scalar adjunction Hom bijection. These conditions normalize the sections and closed comparisons before any gamma equation is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the sequence projection adjunction to A and the actual quotient tower. Identify its right derived direct image with the prescribed total limit using the normalized restriction/limit comparison and uniqueness of right derived functors. Transport the adjunction and its unit/counit projection equations. One flat-term K-flat representative gives the functorial reduction model with strict quotient transitions.

Take the closed derived tensors and their K-flat models on the integral, system and finite sites. Apply canonical tensor pullback to the sequence projection, scalar quotients and vertical evaluation. Identify the localized ordinary comparisons by the already fixed pure-tensor characterizations. The iterated scalar-extension tensor isomorphism makes every reduction transition-adjoint invertible. Retain the ordinary 1 tensor x unit and its localized counit for the finite quotient calculus.

Apply the semilinear derived sections calculus. On normalized inputs finite-prefix induction and its tensor projection formula give the internal-Hom fibers, their evaluation normalization and their actual scalar-extension transitions. Transposition of reduced evaluation gives beta and its finite equation. The ringed pullback Hom theorem gives the system evaluation, transpose and composition identities. Componentwise acyclicity supplies joint conservativity.

Use normalized sequence global sections comparisons, transported by identity on ordinary sections to the recorded coefficient sections functors. Universal derived-unit equations specify scalar and evaluation transports. Define each global Hom fiber as sections of its internal-Hom fiber after the evaluation comparison; its model equation is then the defining composite.

Apply the simultaneous sections/limit comparison with those same derived pairs. Identify both total limits and every sections functor by their universal derived comparisons. Their ordinary comparison is coefficientSectionsLimitIso since the ordinary projections determine it uniquely. Whisker by exact scalar restriction. Its resolution equation is globalLimit_model. Insert the proved closed-adjunction isomorphism as the enriched proof field, and package the remaining normalized scalar/evaluation equations as D.

Retain the actual projection equation from the sections/limit theorem on every system as sections_projection. Normalize finite tensor-Hom currying by ordinary evaluation on the K-flat/K-injective representatives, and use the recorded H-zero cocycle-class identifications. The finite enriched comparison is the extension/restriction Hom bijection on H-zero, giving scalar_hom_zero. These two conditions are independent of enriched gamma and are packaged as CoefficientDerivedSystemProjectionModels.
